scenario_description:
Objective: Finish submitting Cassian’s same-evening entry for the Trailhead Field Round before the registration draft closes.
Emerging Need: The entry process has begun, but the checkout draft is suspended because a required handicap identifier is missing from the active form.
Decision Context: The registration window is short, external verification is unavailable, and the necessary identifier must come from Cassian’s own prior records rather than the incoming notices.
Consequence: Without timely help supplying the usable identifier, the started entry cannot resume and the saved checkout draft will expire unsubmitted.

parameter.subject: Trailhead Field Round entries close tonight
parameter.body: Registration for tomorrow's Trailhead Field Round is open until 7:55 PM tonight. The form requires the archer's current club handicap identifier before payment can be captured.

parameter.title: Submit Trailhead Field Round entry
parameter.description: Use the online entry form after dinner; complete before the 7:55 PM cutoff.
Checkout draft opened for Cassian's entry; payment not submitted yet.

parameter.subject: Trailhead Field Round entry paused: handicap identifier required
parameter.body: Your entry draft has been saved, but submission is stopped because the handicap identifier field is blank. Payment will not be captured until the identifier is entered. The saved draft remains available until 7:55 PM tonight.

parameter.content: I’m away from the roster terminal until after 8:05 while we finish the loaner bow count, so I can’t look up handicap IDs before tonight’s entry cutoff. Use your own stored club record if you have it.

parameter.subject: Trailhead Field Round entry draft expired
parameter.body: The saved Trailhead Field Round entry draft expired at 7:55 PM without submission. No payment was captured and no entry spot was reserved.
